# Retrieval Beyond Documents (RBD) Workshop

> Capability Retrieval for Language Agents. Workshop at NAACL 2027 in San Francisco, California.

RBD at NAACL 2027 explores capability retrieval for language agents: tools, skills, workflows, memory, models, and agents. Topics, submissions, and speakers.

The workshop day and submission portal are to be announced. Author guidelines are a draft; paper limits, eligible ARR cycles, and publication arrangements await the final call. Parent conference dates are not workshop dates.

## Important dates

- Direct paper submission: February 5, 2027
- ARR commitment: March 12, 2027
- Author notification: March 26, 2027
- Camera ready papers: April 16, 2027
- Workshop day: To be announced

All deadlines are at 11:59 p.m. Anywhere on Earth (AoE, UTC-12).
